entries.title: Psalms 77:1
segments:
The psalmist, in deep distress, encourages himself by the remembrance of God's goodness and wonderful dealings towards his people in times past.  According to the opinion of some, he speaks in the name of the afflicted people of God. 
 
While men of the world in their troubles look to creatures for help, or sink down in discouragement, the people of God cry unto him, and he in due time delivers them.

entries.title: Psalms 77:2
segments:
My sore ran; rather, my hand, was spread out; that is, in prayer. 
 
  In the night; his troubles continued while others were refreshed with sleep.

entries.title: Psalms 77:5
segments:
The days of old; when God appeared for the salvation of his people. 
 
A consideration of the mercies of God in times past is well suited to raise the expectation of his help in time to come.

entries.title: Psalms 77:9
segments: Forgotten to be gracious; this the psalmist was tempted to believe.

entries.title: Psalms 77:10
segments:
This is my infirmity; that is, as the original word implies, my affliction, laid upon me by God, and therefore to be borne with faith and patience.  Accordingly the tone of the psalm here changes from the spirit of despondency to that of hope. 
 
  The years of the right hand of the Most High; when he wrought wonders for the deliverance of his people. 
 
Despair of the mercy of God is highly sinful, and a temptation of the devil for the purpose of ruining the souls of men.

entries.title: Psalms 77:13
segments:
In the sanctuary; the place where God is worshipped, and where his character and the reasons of his dealings are best learned. 
 
The house of God is the place where he especially manifests himself to his people, and enables them so to cast their cares upon him as to find that he careth for them.

entries.title: Psalms 77:16
segments:
The waters saw thee; alluding to his wonders at the Red sea. 
 
No obstructions will hinder the salvation of God's people when he appears for their deliverance.  He can open the way for them through the sea, raise up leaders, and guide them safely to his heavenly rest.

entries.title: Psalms 77:19
segments: Thy footsteps are not known; the works and ways of God are inscrutable, and surpass finite comprehension.
